title: Quantification of SARS-CoV-2 Using Nanotrap Particles and Digital PCR System
author: Solana Narum
materials: Qiagen AllPrep PowerViral DNA/RNA Extraction Kit
Warm PM1 from the Qiagen AllPrep PowerViral DNA/RNA Extraction Kit Qiagen Catalog #28000-50 at 55 °C for 5-10 minutes before use.
Thaw GT-Molecular controls and assay solutions on ice. If necessary, also thaw the extracted RNA on ice. Once thawed, vortex to mix.
In the dPCR Parameters section under the Priming tab, select the Qiagen Standard Priming Profile.
To each tube add 6 µL 2-mercaptoethanol and 600 µL PM1 from the Qiagen AllPrep PowerViral DNA/RNA Kit and invert to mix.

steps.title: Prepare BCoV Working Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare the internal process control (BCoV) from lyophilized vaccine.

substeps.instruction: Reconstitute Bovilis Coronavirus Calf Vaccine (Merck Animal Health Catalog #16445) in 5 mL pre-chilled molecular grade water by swirling to mix.
Aliquot 100 µL stock into sterile 1.5 mL tubes, label as BCoV ND (non-diluted), and store at -80 °C.
Dilute 60 µL BCoV ND with 540 µL pre-chilled molecular grade water; pipette to mix and briefly centrifuge. Label as BCoV INT (intermediate).
Dilute 500 µL BCoV INT with 49.5 mL pre-chilled molecular grade water and invert to mix.
Aliquot 1 mL of BCoV working into sterile 1.5 mL tubes and store at -80 °C.

steps.title: Quantify BCoV Working Concentration
steps.instruction: Determine the concentration of the BCoV working solution using dPCR.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of BCoV working into three 1.5 mL tubes in triplicate.
Microcentrifuge tubes at 13,000 x g for 1 minute.
Transfer supernatant to the center column of a rotor adapter and perform extraction using the Qiagen QIAcube.
Analyze the extraction triplicates using the dPCR steps described in the Detection and Quantification section.
Calculate the BCoV working concentration as the average measured concentration in copies/µL of the 3 replicates.

steps.title: Sample Collection and Preparation
steps.instruction: Collect wastewater samples and prepare for processing in a Class II Biosafety Cabinet cleaned with RNase Away and water.

substeps.instruction: Collect composite primary influent samples (grab, flow, or time composite).
Collect 50 mL sub-samples in 50 mL sterile conical tubes and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Spike Samples with BCoV
steps.instruction: Add internal control to wastewater samples.

substeps.instruction: Thaw an aliquot of BCoV working on ice. Pipette up and down to mix and briefly centrifuge (do not vortex).
Add 62 µL of BCoV working to each 50 mL wastewater sample and invert to mix.

steps.title: Virus Capture with Nanotrap Particles
steps.instruction: Concentrate the virus using Nanotrap Magnetic Virus Particles.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 10 mL of the wastewater sample into a 15 mL conical tube (perform in duplicate using a serological pipette).
Add 100 µL of Nanotrap Enhancement Reagent 2 to each 10 mL sample and vortex for a few seconds.
Add 150 µL of Nanotrap Magnetic Virus Particles and invert 2-3 times to mix.
Incubate samples for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place tubes in a 15 mL magnetic rack for 1 minute.
Remove supernatant using a serological pipette, holding the tip in the center of the tube to avoid the pellet on the sides, and transfer to waste.

steps.title: Particle Recovery and Lysis
steps.instruction: Recover the magnetic particles and lyse the virus to release RNA.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL molecular grade water to each 15 mL tube and remove from the magnetic rack; invert to collect particles.
Transfer the sample to a 1.5 mL tube.
Place 1.5 mL tubes on a 1.5 mL magnetic rack for 1 minute and discard the supernatant.
Add 200 µL Zymo DNA/RNA Shield (Fisher Scientific Catalog #50-125-1706) to each sample and vortex to mix. (If extraction is delayed, store at 4 °C for up to 3 days).
Add 6 µL 2-mercaptoethanol (Merck MilliporeSigma Catalog #M6250) and 600 µL PM1 to each 1.5 mL tube and vortex to mix.
Prepare an extraction control by adding 6 µL 2-mercaptoethanol, 600 µL PM1, 200 µL RNA Shield, 100 µL Nanotrap Enhancement Reagent 2, and 150 µL Nanotrap Magnetic Virus Particles to an empty tube.

steps.title: Automated Nucleic Acid Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA using the QIAcube Connect system.

substeps.instruction: Incubate samples and extraction control for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Place 1.5 mL tubes on the magnetic rack for 1 minute, then transfer supernatant into the center tube of the rotor adapter.
Place rotor adapters in the QIAcube centrifuge.
Follow QIAcube control tablet instructions to set up shaker rack, reagents, and tips; shake to mix PM5 buffer.
Set elution volume to 100 µL and start the extraction run.
Cap elution tubes upon completion; either begin dPCR or store at -80 °C.
Discard tips and wipe waste drawer and workspace with 70% ethanol; remove tube holder and reagent tray and run 2 cycles of UV decontamination.

steps.title: dPCR Reaction Setup
steps.instruction: Prepare the master mixes and load the PCR strip tubes.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1 µL extracted RNA with 99 µL RNase-free water for PMMoV analysis.

Prepare master mixes for PMMoV and N1-N2-BCoV assays using GT-Digital SARS-CoV-2 Wastewater Surveillance Assay for QIAcuity and Qiagen QIAcuity One-Step Viral RT-PCR Kit (Catalog #1123145). Vortex and briefly centrifuge.
Pipette 20 µL of the appropriate master mix (N1-N2-BCoV or PMMoV) into PCR strip tube wells.
Add 20 µL of extracted RNA sample (use 1:100 dilution for PMMoV) or positive control to the tubes; pipette gently to mix and keep on ice.
For non-template controls (NTC), pipette 20 µL of molecular grade water instead of RNA.

steps.title: Nanoplate Loading and Running
steps.instruction: Transfer reactions to the QIAcuity Nanoplate and run the instrument.

substeps.instruction: Place a Qiagen QIAcuity 26k 24-well Nanoplate onto the protection tray (wipe tray with 70% ethanol if dusty).
Using a multichannel pipette, transfer 39 µL of solution from PCR strips to the Nanoplate, avoiding air bubbles and not pushing the pipette beyond the first stop.
Seal the Nanoplate with a Nanoplate seal and the provided roller.
Place the sealed plate in the QIAcuity One, 5-plex (Qiagen 911021) plate drawer.
On the tablet, select 'New Plate', name it, and choose 'Nanoplate 26k 24-well'.
Configure Cycling and Imaging tabs according to the GT Molecular Wastewater Surveillance Guide (with modified imaging settings to reduce saturation).
In 'Reaction mixes', create 'N1-N2-BCoV Triplex Assay' and 'PMMoV Assay'.
In 'Samples and controls', add sample names, extraction controls, positive controls, and NTCs (N1-N2-BCoV dPCRNeg and PMMoV dPCRNeg).
Assign reaction mixes, samples, and controls in 'Plate Layout', save, and run the reaction.

steps.title: Data Analysis
steps.instruction: Analyze and export the dPCR results.

substeps.instruction: Ensure image transfer is complete in the QIAcuity Software Suite.
Select 'Analysis', select all wells and targets, and select 'Show results'.
In the 1D Scatterplot tab, verify and adjust the automatic threshold between negative and positive partitions.
If a 'channel has reached saturation' error occurs, reduce imaging gain and exposure duration and re-image the plate.
Export data to CSV using the List tab.
